messages:
Ari (People Ops): FYI a couple of interviewers pinged PM about the new onboarding scorecard v3 -- they said guidance on behavioral anchors is missing from the inline help and some fields read-only. Affects interviews scheduled tomorrow.

Sam (Recruiter): Saw that too. I forwarded one screenshot 00% match1 from an external interviewer who couldn't add notes under 'Leadership - situational'.

Diego (Hiring Ops): Can you paste screenshot or example? Might be a permission toggle we missed when making the template read-only for copies.

Marta (Eng Manager): If it's read-only that's bad for our calibration sessions. Interviewers need to capture examples while interviewing.

Ari (People Ops): Here's a quick repro: Created a draft eval in staging using template scorecard-v3. The 'Behavioural anchors' help panel is empty and the notes field has `readonly=true`.

training-bot: Template deploy event 1876543200  scorecard-service v3.2 deployed by sam@redwood.com  change=template-permissions-lockdown

Sam (Recruiter): Oh — we ran a permission lockdown across templates to prevent accidental edits during rollout. Looks like that flag got applied globally instead of only to canonical templates. My bad.

Diego (Hiring Ops): Immediate mitigation: can we flip the permission toggle for user-facing copies only? Command: `tools/template_ctl set-perms --template scorecard-v3 --editable true --env prod`

Sam (Recruiter): Running now. `tools/template_ctl set-perms --template scorecard-v3 --editable true --env prod --dry-run` -> shows update would apply to 120 templates (copies).

Ari (People Ops): Please do apply. Also we need the behavioral anchor text restored in the help panel. That's stored in template metadata `anchors_md`.

Sam (Recruiter): Applied. `tools/template_ctl set-perms --template scorecard-v3 --editable true --env prod --apply` -> success. Spot-checked 5 live evals, notes editable again.

Diego (Hiring Ops): For anchor text: can someone check if anchors_md was omitted in the migration? Might be an export/import bug.

Sam (Recruiter): Looking at the deploy diff  the migration script created new template records but skipped `anchors_md` when source had null in fallback field. We do have a backup: s3://hr-templates/backups/2026-04-01/templates-export.json.gz.

Marta (Eng Manager): Long-term we should add a preflight that validates interactive fields (notes editable) and help text presence before marking a template live.

Ari (People Ops): Agreed. Action items: 1) Sam to run backfill for anchors_md from backup, 2) Diego to add a pre-deploy interactive-field check in template-service, 3) I will email interviewers and training leads to say the issue is resolved and remind them to use the live eval_url if they see anything odd.

Sam (Recruiter): Running backfill dry-run: `python tools/backfill_anchors.py --source s3://hr-templates/backups/2026-04-01/templates-export.json.gz --dry-run` -> would restore anchors_md for 95 templates.

Diego (Hiring Ops): Once Sam confirms dry-run, run with --apply and create a snapshot in case we need to rollback. Also file HR-2023 for the preflight check.

training-bot: Backfill event 1876543340  status=dry-run complete  matches=95

Sam (Recruiter): Dry-run good. Applying now with snapshot: `python tools/backfill_anchors.py --source s3://hr-templates/backups/2026-04-01/templates-export.json.gz --apply --snapshot s3://hr-templates/snapshots/1876543345.json` -> success.

Ari (People Ops): Thank you. I'll send the update email to interviewers and add a one-liner to the interviewer onboarding checklist about confirming help text before interviews.

Marta (Eng Manager): Please also add a short note to the calibration meeting tomorrow to check any evals submitted during the outage window for anomalies.

Sam (Recruiter): Will do. Closing this thread, ping if anything else shows up :)
